subject.title: fix: bound osascript wait with the shared process timeout

question: Should send, react, and Messages launcher operations adopt fixed 60-second and 15-second subprocess deadlines instead of retaining their former unbounded wait behavior?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent and follows the existing attachment-conversion policy, but applying that policy to established interactive command paths intentionally changes what slow existing workflows observe.

options.title: Accept bounded waits
options.body: Merge the shared timeout policy to prevent indefinite CLI and RPC stalls, accepting timeout errors for unusually slow helper runs.

options.title: Narrow the initial scope
options.body: Limit this PR to the AppleScript paths and defer `killall` and `csrutil` timeout policy until launcher-specific behavior is reviewed separately.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded waits
recommendation.body: Merge the shared timeout policy to prevent indefinite CLI and RPC stalls, accepting timeout errors for unusually slow helper runs.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature history connects this contributor to both the existing timeout policy and the proposed shared implementation; the final contract decision still requires project approval.
